actionPreparationNotes: Lulo is Blink-backed. Ask for asset, amount, and action URL before prepare. For withdrawals and rewards, require position facts instead of guessing balances.
riskNotes: Surface APY, liquidity, and withdrawal constraints when available. Do not describe yield as guaranteed.
walletApprovalBoundary: Lulo actions are approval-bound. The agent prepares a review item only; the wallet signs separately.
